name: Pokemon Stadium 2 Overworld Models - Gold/Silver (Gen 2)
description: Standalone Gold/Silver Gen-2 voxel + Stadium 2 mod. v0.2.81 makes trainer FOLLOW mode track the selected party slot (slot 1 by default), so PARTY -> SWITCH immediately replaces the visible follower instead of keeping the original starter fingerprint. Also refreshes same-species/shiny leader swaps. Keeps full-color 2D followers, DSM7 symmetric eye sampling, National-number Pokedex ordering, independent Pokemon/player 3D toggles, Stadium-style UI, extended OPEN WORLD zoom, seamless followers, roaming Wilds, voxel terrain and Character Selector coexistence.
